mapper.select: select suggestion_id, account_id, suggestion_image_addr, suggestion_description, create_time, is_ack from suggestion where is_ack=false order by suggestion_id desc limit #{start},#{need}
mapper.update: update suggestion set is_ack=true where suggestion_id=#{suggestionId} and is_ack=false
mapper.select: select suggestion_image_addr from suggestion where suggestion_id=#{suggestionId} and is_ack=true
